Hi Kevin,

Thanks for following up, and I am sorry you have had to ask twice.

First the good news on the H15, Shop····: the $200 went back to your original payment method on October 28, so that part is settled. The unit itself ships November 30.

Harlo B30, Shop····, also ships November 30. Both of those are still ahead of us and on track.

The two I owe you a straight answer on are the Magic M. 40T (address hidden), Shop····, which was stamped November 14, and the GekkoScience KBOX, Shop····, which was stamped October 31. Neither has shipped and neither is on the shelf at our Tennessee warehouse yet, so both are past their dates. We did not write to you about either, and we should have. I have put both in front of the team with your second Magic M., Shop···· on Batch 8, which still carries no date of its own. Someone is picking that up and will come back to you with the real dates on all three.

For the wait, I have put $50 off your next order on your account: code HD-••••••, yours alone, good on orders over $200.

You can watch the incoming batches here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status, and tracking emails out automatically as soon as each label prints.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
